items.text: beds fade: switching or stopping a water bed or a pack's bed sound fades it down over about two seconds while the next one rises; a bed that keeps playing is left alone
Stream is a little bubbling brook now; the old sound is kept and named for what it is, Garden hose; and a new bed, Lapping waves: tiny waves at a lakeshore, against a dock and the stones
the Color panel says Color · and what it colors (Color · Ground); Lines and Second are Line 1 and Line 2, Mix is Line mix
in the Color panel the small square says wheel (your device's color picker), the switch says what it is and whether it's on (Line 1 on), and How it works (i) explains each element
the Color panel has ‹ › to the next panel and its ring in its band
drag the speaker left or right for the volume, as the dice do; down and up open its shelf and panel as before
stepping from one panel to the next with ‹ ›, a pinned ring goes along: it becomes the next panel's ring, in the same place
a ring opened from a panel stays on the stage when the panel closes, as long as it is pinned; unpinned, it goes with the panel

more than one ring. On a computer with room, a double tap while a ring is pinned opens another; the pinned one stays, a step back, and a touch takes it in hand again. Settings › Another ring: With room, Always or Never
a double tap on the stage brings back the last ring you opened there; a ring opened from a panel's ring button belongs to that panel and doesn't change it
adding a pack from a file or the library works again (0.33.98 broke it)
a pack in Pack has Restore (↺): it comes back as it was made, with its own parts, timing and levels; and a bin that takes the whole pack out of your sounds
removing a sound takes it out of your sounds, not out of the library; for half a minute Pack offers Put it back

in Pack, each sound shows ▶ Listen (only you hear it) and its parts as switches: Field, Beat, Touch, Pattern. Light any of them: the same sound can play in the field and under your finger. A sound keeps one part at least; the round on/off switch is gone
what plays is chosen under the bar, and a scene you save remembers which pack sounds play and where; a lit dot beside a sound in Pack says it is playing now
the parts use the bar's names everywhere: Field (was Bed) and Beat (was On the beat)
pro: changing where a pack's sounds play, and Pattern sounds, are Pro (open while in beta); adding and playing packs is for everyone
the Seed words row wears the Seed tile's sprout beside its word
the drawer under the bar is never empty: in Field and Touch it shows every source's sounds, grouped under each one's dot (Water, then your packs); a tap plays it and lights its source above
headings say the choice: Which way · Forward, Lands on · Beat, Every · 15 s, Moves · Breathe, Move · Sine
+ in the sound shelf is the pack's cube with a plus, and a pack's name sits in the normal ink

Settings › Words: Always, Learn or Never. Learn (the default) shows the words beside the icons and fades each one once you know that control; a finger brings it back. Never is icons only, for small children
the Pro padlocks sit top right and quiet
choose above, play below: Beats, Field and Touch and the source (Water, your packs, +) sit in the sound shelf above the bar; the drawer under the bar holds only what plays
